# Speedrun.com — recording a wrapped game

- Original source: [Speedrun.com — recording a wrapped game](https://www.speedrun.com/de-DE/robinhood/forums/mjg89)
- Author / publication: MasterEbro and 23Banzaj / Speedrun.com forum
- Language / date: English discussion; exact dates not verified
- Access: Discussion text inspected
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

MasterEbro reports receiving audio with a black image when recording through OBS or Game Bar while using a windowing wrapper. Another participant suggests alternative capture tools and windowed operation.

The original poster later reports success after changing a checkbox and a value in the wrapper configuration. Those settings are not named, so the exchange does not provide a reproducible fix.

This is a firsthand compatibility lead for recording old Windows graphics through wrappers. It supports checking capture configuration, but does not establish a general solution or prove that the game renderer itself is faulty.

[MasterEbro](/de-DE/users/MasterEbro)[2 years ago](/de-DE/posts/xpcr1)

Hello, I have just started trying to speedrun some levels from this game, but I am having difficulties capturing any footage from my runs.

I have tried using OBS Studio (both Game Capture and Display Capture) and Microsoft Game Bar to record runs but both only record a black screen (audio records fine). Both methods work on any other game I have tried to use them with, but Robin Hood is rejecting everything I throw at it! The closest I've got is using OBS Display Capture, which will record the 'Wanadoo' logo while the game is loading, but everything after that is a black screen.

Has anyone else had these problems, or have any setup suggestions which might help? I am using DxWnd so that the game runs properly but otherwise it is as installed, and everything has been run with administrative privileges. Any help would be greatly appreciated!

[](/de-DE/users/23Banzaj)

[23Banzaj](/de-DE/users/23Banzaj)

Hello, For My Recordings I Used GeForce Experience Mixed With Fraps Footage. You Can Try Windowed Mode:  It Helps. Regards, Matthew

[](/de-DE/users/MasterEbro)

[MasterEbro](/de-DE/users/MasterEbro)[2 years ago](/de-DE/posts/u6yvn)

Hi Matthew,

Thank you so much! It turns out that when I installed DxWnd and DSWin8 several years ago I missed one tick box and didn't change one value respectively - not enough to stop the game running well, but enough to make screen capture impossible! All working now.

Many thanks, MasterEbro.
